en: Vintage sepia postcard with Hungarian text. The front shows a pavilion‑like exhibition building with multiple tiered roofs and an entrance gate, likely a temporary structure on exhibition grounds. People stand at the entrance; the surroundings are open grounds with paths and some construction materials. The reverse side has a typical divided‑back layout with Hungarian headings and space for address and stamp.
